purpose: Small paired engineering value gate for evidence-grounded candidate proposals; no training benefit claim.

design.statistical_unit: case; repetitions nested within case, cases clustered by policy ancestry/session
design.independence_claim: No independent-lineage or generalization claim from 12 cases.
design.order: balanced A/T order within case/repetition; shuffled case order; mapping withheld from reviewer
design.case_scope: Predeclared neutral task/stratum/logical-run focus; retain the same complete denominator and production default selector. No experiment-only episode mining.
design.observation_reuse: Repeated views of two observation packages; report within-case fresh-repeat variability separately.

arms.A: Current task-owned public aggregate/runtime feedback at the same as-of cutoff.
arms.T: Same source/permission/time cutoff; task-owned bounded behavior subtree within public_feedback_summary. Exact differences and any displaced task sections are frozen from real builder preflight; default selector only.
shared: static admission and CPU component smoke

provider.input_count_authority: provider_usage_prompt_tokens; local estimate is preflight only
provider.credential_check: remote file exists and readable; value not read/exported, no network credential validation

budget.planned_gpu_capacity_hours: All actual public-dev replay attempts, failed starts and replacement runs share the 2 GPU-capacity-hour ceiling; record the executed case inventory, not only author cases. No training.
budget.unknown_outcome: consumes reserved attempt and worst-case USD; never blindly resubmit
budget.pricing_basis: conservative peak prices verified by root; no assumed cache discount
budget.charge_policy: all attempted requests including source followup, repair, malformed output, transport failure and unknown outcome
budget.stop_before_request: remaining stage USD must cover full 40000 input + 32768 output reservation
budget.input_overflow: actual usage above 40000 is protocol failure; preserve and charge the attempt, halt pending review; no free replacement
budget.pricing_bound_status: 12.317184 USD assumes each attempt stays inside frozen 40k input/32768 output units. Original production CostGuardedProvider enforces reservation and stops after a usage overrun; actual USD audit is separate.

context.preflight_estimator: Use production frame/budget metadata and existing input_units_per_attempt_reserve=40000. No old P0 estimator is an exact token bound; provider usage is authoritative.
context.T_default_working_set: Task production default bounded behavior view; no case-specific hand-picked transcripts. Same neutral case focus in A/T; if requested evidence is omitted, that limitation remains a genuine test outcome.
context.capacity_regression: Keep P1 real-history floors: Stair g13>=11,g16>=13; Push g6>=5. Do not allocate a new memory column.

human_review.ground_truth: same public-dev readonly timelines and source code; candidate proposals/hidden future outcomes excluded
human_review.claim: single-reviewer consistency only; cannot claim independent inter-rater agreement

gates.optional_cost_route: Not selected. This stage preregisters the quality-gain gate; costs are descriptive and cannot rescue a failed quality gate after observing outputs.
gates.no_training_outcome_prediction_accuracy: No later training is run; grade falsifiability and evidence support, not prospective improvement hit rate.

freeze_requirements: 12 populated cases and at least 2 preregistered process categories
common A/T context and precise T replacements reviewed
deterministic case/episode selectors fixed before author outputs
budget preflight of all first prompts; actual provider usage audited
source snapshot and model/price configuration fingerprinted
root notified that data card is frozen before any API execution
scope_limitations: Ablation concerns default evidence package quality, not a scientific RL benefit.
Historical A outputs are baselines only, never fresh-arm substitutes.
No API/GPU execution was performed by preparing this card.
